app.name: CAFM - POC
app.description: Contractor-shaped CAFM for Dutco Construction (demo): handover, DLP liability, work orders, compliance, plant.

fields.name: Licence Days Left
fields.formula: IF(ABS(YEAR(Trade_Licence_Expiry) * 372 + MONTH(Trade_Licence_Expiry) * 31 + DAY(Trade_Licence_Expiry) - (YEAR(TODAY()) * 372 + MONTH(TODAY()) * 31 + DAY(TODAY()))) = YEAR(Trade_Licence_Expiry) * 372 + MONTH(Trade_Licence_Expiry) * 31 + DAY(Trade_Licence_Expiry) - (YEAR(TODAY()) * 372 + MONTH(TODAY()) * 31 + DAY(TODAY())), DATEDIFF(TODAY(), Trade_Licence_Expiry, "Day"), 0 - DATEDIFF(TODAY(), Trade_Licence_Expiry, "Day"))

fields.name: Days To Expiry
fields.formula: IF(ABS(YEAR(Expires_On) * 372 + MONTH(Expires_On) * 31 + DAY(Expires_On) - (YEAR(TODAY()) * 372 + MONTH(TODAY()) * 31 + DAY(TODAY()))) = YEAR(Expires_On) * 372 + MONTH(Expires_On) * 31 + DAY(Expires_On) - (YEAR(TODAY()) * 372 + MONTH(TODAY()) * 31 + DAY(TODAY())), DATEDIFF(TODAY(), Expires_On, "Day"), 0 - DATEDIFF(TODAY(), Expires_On, "Day"))

fields.name: DLP Covered
fields.formula: IF(ABS(YEAR(DLP_End_Date) * 372 + MONTH(DLP_End_Date) * 31 + DAY(DLP_End_Date) - (YEAR(First_Contact_At) * 372 + MONTH(First_Contact_At) * 31 + DAY(First_Contact_At))) = YEAR(DLP_End_Date) * 372 + MONTH(DLP_End_Date) * 31 + DAY(DLP_End_Date) - (YEAR(First_Contact_At) * 372 + MONTH(First_Contact_At) * 31 + DAY(First_Contact_At)), 1, 0)

fields.name: Warranty Covered
fields.formula: IF(ABS(YEAR(Warranty_End_Date) * 372 + MONTH(Warranty_End_Date) * 31 + DAY(Warranty_End_Date) - (YEAR(First_Contact_At) * 372 + MONTH(First_Contact_At) * 31 + DAY(First_Contact_At))) = YEAR(Warranty_End_Date) * 372 + MONTH(Warranty_End_Date) * 31 + DAY(Warranty_End_Date) - (YEAR(First_Contact_At) * 372 + MONTH(First_Contact_At) * 31 + DAY(First_Contact_At)), 1, 0)
